g.text: Where the LitOpt / wet-lab difference comes from

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: Holding the knockout background fixed and swapping only the anaplerotic enzyme gives no difference — PPC and PYC are stoichiometrically equivalent. Comparing the genotypes as specified does give a difference, and Δpta accounts for

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: essentially all of it: the wet-lab build does not delete pta, so acetate overflow still drains carbon. Adding Δpta would capture most of LitOpt's advantage.
